Cost: 2 Investiture

The machine does not tire. The machine does not mourn.

Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, your Combat Construct gains an additional attack per turn. When your Construct reduces a character to 0 HP, you may immediately command it to move up to 15 ft and make a free Strike against a character within reach.

Cost: 2 Investiture

The walls have teeth now. Come in.

Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, each of your Foundations becomes fortified: enemies treat fortified Foundations as difficult terrain, and when an enemy enters a fortified Foundation, it takes [Tier][Die] impact damage and tests Agility vs. your Red; on a failure, it is Slowed until the start of its next turn. Your Combat Construct standing in a fortified Foundation gains +2 to all defenses.

Cost: 1 Investiture

He set the chisel down. The stone stood up.

Spend 1 Investiture and forge a Combat Construct in an adjacent space for the scene. The Construct has HP equal to [Tier][Die] + your tier x 2, deflect 1, Speed 25 ft, defenses equal to yours minus 2, and one melee attack per turn dealing [Tier][Die] impact damage. It acts on your initiative immediately after your turn. If destroyed, you may reforge it by using this talent again. You may sustain one active Construct.
